title: ProvisionUserRequest
description: POST /v1/provisioning/users. Shared daemon, platform operator only (docs/harness/shared-hosting.md §6).

externalSubject.description: The gateway's stable id for the user, conventionally <idp>:<id>. Idempotency key; never stored.

tokenLabel.description: Label of the token minted by this call; defaults to gateway.
